title: Leeds United: Farke's 'bored' quip hides a shaky run of form
body:

The only detail we hold is that headline, so the quip is the story as far as the evidence goes [S1]. We do not know what the frenzy involved or what followed it, so readers should treat the joke as a window rather than the full picture [S1].

The form numbers tell a harder story. Across their last five league matches, Leeds United have one win, two draws and two defeats, collecting 5 points [ST1]. They have scored 3 and conceded 5, with the sequence running LDDLW [ST1].

A side that can laugh off a bad week has the luxury of a strong base, and a run like this one calls for answers on the pitch rather than punchlines. The mood around the club should be about fixing the problems, not enjoying the banter.

The Touchline Take: the quip is harmless, but the run behind it is the real story, and one to keep an eye on.
